description: The pie chart, titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM),” visually represents the proportional allocation of token routing across three distinct categories within the Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Model (FedHLM) framework. The largest segment, occupying 94.5% of the chart and colored green, is labeled “LOCAL,” indicating the dominant routing path for tokens. A smaller red segment, labeled “LLM,” accounts for 3.9% of the distribution, while an even smaller blue segment, labeled “EDGE_P2P,” represents 1.6%. The chart employs a simple color-coded legend implicitly through direct labeling on the slices, with the “LOCAL” segment visually emphasized by its overwhelming size and central placement, while the “LLM” and “EDGE_P2P” segments are depicted as narrow wedges radiating from the center. The percentages are clearly marked inside each slice, and the overall layout suggests a highly centralized routing behavior with minimal offloading to LLM or peer-to-peer edge nodes.
